title: At-Tariq 86:5-8 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: Al-A'la, At-Tariq 1 to 8 and waqf
source: Written for quran/y5 lesson 29 (Pupil PDF worksheet: At-Tariq 86:5-8 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 29. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ (٥) خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٍۢ دَافِقٍۢ (٦) يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ ٱلصُّلْبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ (٧) إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٌۭ (٨)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: So let man observe from what he was created.
He was created from a fluid, ejected,
Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.
Indeed, Allah, to return him [to life], is Able.

head: Word
Where
Rule
How to read it
rows: Two counts on the small yaa

keywords.def: so let him look and think

questions.q: Chunk and link At-Tariq 86:5-8 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 86:5-8 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 86:5-8 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Recite At-Tariq 86:1 to 8 to a partner, stopping correctly at each ayah end.
Name every noon sakinah rule in 86:5 to 8.
questions.a: 86:5 فَلْيَنظُرِ: ikhfa; 86:6 مِن مَّآءٍ: idgham with ghunnah; 86:7 مِنۢ بَيْنِ: iqlab.
A) return a person to life. 86:8: 'Indeed, Allah, to return him [to life], is Able.'

questions.q: Think again: Allah tells us to look at how we were created (86:5). Why does thinking about our small beginning make us humble?
questions.a: We began small and weak; Allah made us and can bring us back to life (86:8). So we should be grateful, not proud.
